scripts.sandbox:build: sh -c 'c="${INSTALL_CURSOR:-}"; if [ -z "$c" ]; then printf "Install Cursor CLI in the sandbox image? [y/N]: "; read a || a=; case "$a" in y|Y|yes|YES) c=1;; *) c=0;; esac; fi; [ "$c" = 1 ] || c=0; k="${INSTALL_CLAUDE:-}"; if [ -z "$k" ]; then printf "Install Claude Code CLI in the sandbox image? [y/N]: "; read a || a=; case "$a" in y|Y|yes|YES) k=1;; *) k=0;; esac; fi; [ "$k" = 1 ] || k=0; docker build --build-arg INSTALL_CURSOR=$c --build-arg INSTALL_CLAUDE=$k -t prompt-arena-agent:local sandbox'
scripts.sandbox:build:preview: docker build --build-arg PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION=$(node -p "require('playwright/package.json').version") -f sandbox/preview.Dockerfile -t prompt-arena-preview:local sandbox
